items.title: Show HN: A local merge queue for parallel Claude Code agents
items.summary_raw: I have been pushing up to 90 commits a day on a MacBook Air via 4-5 parallel agents. As you can imagine when all the agents try to build, test and run dev servers on an 8GB machine it is the fast lane to a force quit and restart. I also did not want to pay the CI minutes on 90 pushes a day. So I designed a local merge queue to have all commits land one at a time and fully tested. Hopefully this helps other folks with more modest machines. Appreciate any feedback. Comments URL: https://news.ycomb

items.title: Images show near-complete prototype of swimming pool designed to float in New York river
items.summary_raw: The first phase of a floating pool planned for the East River is nearing completion in Brooklyn, with a barge and an infiltration system designed to clean river water as it flows into the structure. items.title: Mark Zuckerberg is planning a big push into personal AI agents
items.summary_raw: Meta is all-in on AI, and sometime soon, the company is going to make a big push into personal AI agents that can do things on your behalf. items.title: Qualcomm is raising phone chip prices starting September 1st
items.summary_raw: RAMageddon won't be the only reason your next phone costs more - Qualcomm is about to raise prices on all its processors, as well. items.title: Two colours of brick give Quebec apartment building "painterly dimension"
items.summary_raw: Montreal-based studio ACDF Architecture has rounded select corners of an apartment building in Quebec, Canada, and used a two-tone brick cladding system to create an interesting optical effect. Known as Mellem Manoir-des-Trembles, the building contains nearly 200 rental units in Gatineau, just north of Ottawa. items.title: xAI’s last-minute scramble to stop Minnesota’s anti-nudification app law
items.summary_raw: xAI is suing Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison over a law passed back in May that broadly targets "nudification" apps, claiming that the statute's punitive provisions leave the company with "no practical choice but to restrict Grok Imagine's image-editing features in various ways." The law, the company argues, violates the First Amendment. Back in January, […]

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 packs a lot of fun into its discounted $20 price

items.title: Bricolage uses salvaged bricks for self-build home in London

The three-bedroom home was designed and built by Bricolage founder Will Howard and his wife, Sogand Howard, for their own family on a back-garden site at the rear of a Victorian terrace.
